maddeler.e:
نختزل (form VIII)
# نَخْتَزِلُ (naḵtazilu) /nax.ta.zi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# نُخْتَزَلُ (nuḵtazalu) /nux.ta.za.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# نَخْتَزِلَ (naḵtazila) /nax.ta.zi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# نُخْتَزَلَ (nuḵtazala) /nux.ta.za.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
